preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have n vertices and m edges within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t
preconditions.description: The start vertex s and end vertex t must be valid and distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
